

# Load libaries sf, tmap, tidyverse, spData
```{r}
library(sf)
library(tmap)
library(tidyverse)
library(stars)
library(here)
```

```{r}
ej_screen <- st_read(here("EDS223-HW2", "data", "ejscreen", "EJSCREEN_2023_BG_StatePct_with_AS_CNMI_GU_VI.gdb"))

inequality <- st_read(here("EDS223-HW2","data", "mapping-inequality", "mapping-inequality-los-angeles.json"))
```

# Filter to Los Angeles County
```{r}
california <- ej_screen %>%
  dplyr::filter(ST_ABBREV == "CA")

los_angeles<- california %>%
  dplyr::filter(CNTY_NAME %in% c("Los Angeles County"))
```

```{r}
st_crs(los_angeles)
st_crs(inequality)
st_crs(los_angeles) == st_crs(inequality)
la_transform <- st_transform(los_angeles, crs = st_crs(inequality))
if(st_crs(la_transform) == st_crs(inequality)){
  print("it's a match!")
} else {
  print("still not a match")
}
```

```{r}
la_transform <- st_make_valid(la_transform)
inequality <- st_make_valid(inequality)
la_inequality <- st_join(la_transform, inequality, left = FALSE)
```

### Base map of Los Angeles county
```{r}
tm_shape(la_inequality)+
    tm_borders()
    tm_title("Los Angeles County")+
tm_compass(position = c('right', 'top'))+
tm_scalebar()
```

### Map of historical redlining
```{r}
tm_shape(la_inequality)+
    tm_borders()+
    tm_fill('grade')+
    tm_title("Los Angeles County")+
tm_compass(position = c('right', 'top'))+
tm_scalebar()
```
